evidence.fact: The base description says the model includes completed-order revenue and excludes refunded and cancelled orders.
The existing override replaced that description with “Revenue from all orders at one row per order date.”
The model filters for completed orders and groups by order_date before summing amount.
The manifest records daily_revenue as depending on stg_orders and carries the matching completed-order description and order_date grain.
The bounded profile found 5 completed, 1 refunded, and 1 cancelled source orders; daily_revenue has 4 rows spanning 4 distinct dates.

models:
  - name: stg_orders
    description: One row per source order, including all lifecycle statuses.
    config:
      meta:
        owner: data-platform
        lifecycle: active
        grain: order_id
    columns:
      - name: order_id
        description: Source order identifier.
        data_tests: [not_null, unique]
      - name: customer_id
        description: Customer that placed the order.
        data_tests: [not_null]
      - name: status
        description: Current order lifecycle status.
        data_tests:
          - accepted_values:
              arguments:
                values: [completed, refunded, cancelled]
      - name: order_date
        description: Date the order was placed.
        data_tests: [not_null]

  - name: customer_orders
    description: Completed-order metrics at one row per customer; refunded and cancelled orders are excluded.
    config:
      meta:
        owner: analytics
        lifecycle: active
        grain: customer_id
    columns:
      - name: customer_id
        description: Customer identifier and model grain.
        data_tests: [not_null, unique]
      - name: completed_order_count
        description: Number of completed orders for the customer.

  - name: daily_revenue
    description: Completed-order revenue at one row per order date; refunded and cancelled orders are excluded.
    config:
      meta:
        owner: finance-analytics
        lifecycle: active
        grain: order_date
    columns:
      - name: order_date
        description: Order date and model grain.
        data_tests: [not_null, unique]
      - name: completed_order_count
        description: Number of completed orders on the date.
      - name: completed_revenue
        description: Sum of completed order amounts on the date.

select
    order_date,
    count(*) as completed_order_count,
    sum(amount) as completed_revenue
from {{ ref('stg_orders') }}
where status = 'completed'
group by order_date
